page.overview:
Who is Lubewig?

Lubewig is a tourist who appears briefly in Paris in the film. He appears to be a cheap car in very bad shape. He is seen waiting for the painter to finish his (idealized) portrait with his wife Geartrude, in front of the Sacré-Cœur Basilica, carrying a lot of luggage on top of his roof.
